body: In `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs` line 727, the unconditional `self.state.refresh_habitat_registry()` at the end of `process_action` runs after every player action including `Feed`, `AddShrimp`, `RemoveShrimp`, and `SiphonDetritus`, none of which modify habitat-relevant state (geometry, hardware, plants, substrate, or filter). Consider either (a) making the refresh conditional on action type, or (b) adding a brief comment explaining that the unconditional approach is an intentional simplicity-over-performance trade-off. This prevents future confusion about whether the unconditional call is deliberate or an oversight.
